slide.text: AI helps Kano scale intake without weakening control
For Kano, AI adds value when it reduces repetitive intake work, supports cleaner certification workflows, and still leaves final authority with the responsible officer.

text.p: Parcel claims, supporting documents, and applicant details take longer to prepare when staff must re-enter large portions of each case by hand.
That burden becomes heavier when title-generation, registry cleanup, and post-title transactions all rely on consistent underlying data.
The result is slower throughput, more clerical drift, and more effort spent on correction rather than review judgment.
Uploaded PDFs and images can prefill parcel and certificate fields, improving consistency and reducing repetitive clerical work.
Side-by-side verification lets officers compare extracted values with the original evidence before a record is saved or advanced.
Because field provenance is preserved, Kano can scale processing speed without weakening accountability inside the audit trail.

slide.text: The procurement value is disciplined acceleration: faster intake, cleaner records, and stronger reviewer confidence.
